title: c51 explores reactive-marangoni: burning pockets on a regrowing fuel at a surface whose compressible Marangoni flow (deep-layer response) runs toward or away from heat, with no gravity
summary: Screen first: with flow away from heat the pockets disperse and die; with flow toward heat (self-rewetting sign) compact hot spots form, seem to move and multiply. Next: labkit packs, m=0 twin, motion and division counts; sighting if it holds.
